title: Senior / Lead UI/UX Designer (Web & Mobile Applications)
description:
**Job Title:** Senior / Lead Product Designer (UI/UX)

**Department:** Product Design & User Experience

**Experience Level:** 5 – 10 Years

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Purpose

We are looking for a visionary, user-obsessed, and versatile **Senior UI/UX Designer** with 5 to 10 years of experience designing high-impact digital products across both **web applications and mobile platforms (iOS & Android)**.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end design lifecycle of our core digital products—transforming complex workflows and ambiguous business problems into seamless, intuitive, and visually stunning user experiences. You will bridge user research, interaction design, and visual craftsmanship while collaborating closely with product managers and engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Product Design (Web & Mobile)

* **Web App Design:** Architect scalable, data-dense, and responsive web application interfaces (dashboards, SaaS platforms, complex data workflows) optimized for performance and usability.
* **Mobile App Design:** Design native mobile application experiences (iOS & Android) adhering to Human Interface Guidelines (HIG) and Material Design principles, focusing on touch targets, thumb zones, and mobile-first micro-interactions.
* **User Journey & Architecture:** Create information architectures, user flows, wireframes, and interactive low-to-high fidelity prototypes to test and validate concepts quickly.

2. User Research & Data-Driven Strategy

* **Discovery & Testing:** Conduct user interviews, surveys, usability testing sessions, and competitive audits to uncover deep user needs, pain points, and behavioral insights.
* **Continuous Iteration:** Analyze post-launch product analytics, heatmaps, and funnel drop-offs to drive continuous, data-backed design improvements.

3. UI Craftsmanship & Design Systems

* **Visual Excellence:** Deliver pixel-perfect UI layouts, typography structures, and accessible color schemes that elevate brand identity across all device screens.
* **Design System Ownership:** Build, scale, and maintain comprehensive cross-platform Design Systems and component libraries (tokens, responsive grids, shared UI kits) in Figma to ensure design consistency between web and mobile.
* **Accessibility (a11y):** Ensure designs meet **WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA** standards for web and mobile accessibility.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership

* **Engineering Handoff:** Partner seamlessly with frontend and mobile developers, providing detailed specs,responsive layout rules, and design tokens to ensure flawless implementation.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:** Present design strategies and rationales clearly to product leaders and executive stakeholders.
* **Mentorship:** Guide and mentor junior/mid-level designers on best practices for cross-platform app design.

Required Technical Skills & Qualifications

* **Experience:** 5 to 10 years of professional UI/UX design experience, with a proven, verifiable track record of launching and scaling **both web applications and mobile apps**.
* **Portfolio Requirement:** A comprehensive portfolio showcasing live web apps and mobile apps, detailing your end-to-end design process (research, wireframes, user testing, design system usage, and final screens).
* **Design Tools:** Expert-level mastery of **Figma** (Advanced Auto Layout, component variants, cross-platform prototyping). Familiarity with user testing and analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Hotjar, Maze).
* **Technical Literacy:** Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and modern frontend/mobile constraints (React,Flutter, or native iOS/Android layout logic) to ensure seamless engineering collaboration.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design, Graphic Design, or equivalent practical experience.

Soft Skills & Professional Attributes

* **Systems Thinker:** Ability to look at a product holistically and design seamless cross-device experiences (desktop to mobile transitions).
* **Problem Solver:** Exceptional ability to simplify complex logic into frictionless user flows.
* **Communication & Empathy:** Strong storytelling and advocacy skills to champion the user's voice across the organization.

Pay: ₹11,000.00 - ₹49,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: iOS Engineering Manager
description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.

#### **What you will do**

The position plays a critical role in the software development process, guiding the creation of scalable, maintainable, and robust software solutions that align with the organization's business objectives and technical requirements. The position takes ownership to:

* Lead, mentor, and develop Android engineers to achieve technical and professional growth.
* Establish a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive towards implementing software product to allow for iterative, autonomous development and future scaling.
* Conduct performance evaluations, career development discussions, and succession planning.
* Creating and onboarding project teams, integrating them into the organization and providing a clear vision of the product.
* Recruit, onboard, and retain top engineering talent.
* Facilitate effective communication and collaboration across distributed and cross-functional teams.

#### **What you bring**

The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise in mobile application development with proven leadership capabilities to drive engineering excellence, mentor teams, and align technology solutions with Product Architects to deliver business objectives.

* 15-20 years of Hands-on experience developing native mobile applications using:
* iOS: Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit
* Strong knowledge of CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps practices, and cloud platforms.
* 3+ years of people management experience leading engineering teams.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Product Architects, Marketing teams, Experience designers, Quality representatives and Engineers to plan and deliver market leading Software.
* Works to build and improve strong relationships with engineers and managers across the organization as well as relevant business stakeholders for several teams.

#### **Who we are**

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

*WSA is an equal-opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.*

title: Senior IOS Engineer
description:
### **Description**

We are looking for a highly skilled iOS/tvOS Developer to join our team and take a leading role in building and enhancing our OTT video streaming applications. Your primary responsibility will be to develop and optimize a custom video player experience for both iOS and tvOS, leveraging AVPlayer and related media frameworks. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and backend engineering teams to deliver a seamless, high-performance user experience.

  

### **What you'll be doing:**

  

* Design, develop, and maintain OTT streaming applications for iOS and tvOS using Swift.
* Build and optimize a custom AVPlayer-based video player, including playback controls, UI layers, gesture handling, and state management.
* Implement features such as Multiview, DRM, subtitles/closed captions, adaptive bitrate streaming (HLS), and background playback.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to create intuitive and visually polished user interfaces.
* Integrate with backend APIs for content catalog, analytics, and player events.
* Ensure high performance, low memory usage, and smooth playback on both iOS and tvOS devices.
* Debug and resolve complex playback issues, buffering/latency problems, and platform-specific behaviors.
* Write clean, maintainable code following best architectural practices.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving overall engineering standards.
* Stay up to date with Apple platform updates, new APIs, and best practices.

### **What you'll bring:**

  

* 5–7+ years of professional experience in Swift development.
* Strong expertise with AVPlayer, AVFoundation, HLS streaming, and media playback architecture.
* Proven experience building and releasing iOS and/or tvOS applications.
* Solid understanding of UI frameworks (UIKit; SwiftUI is a plus).
* Experience with performance optimization, memory profiling, and debugging tools (Instruments, Console, etc.).
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON parsing, and networking frameworks (URLSession, Combine, etc.).
* Experience implementing subtitles, DRM (FairPlay), and custom playback logic.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

### **About DAZN**

At DAZN, we bring ambition to life. We are innovators, game-changers and pioneers. So, if you want to push boundaries and make an impact, DAZN is the place to be.

As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make your mark and the power to make change happen. We're doing things no-one has done before, giving fans and customers access to sport anytime, anywhere. We're using world-class technology to transform sports and revolutionise the industry and we're not going to stop.

**DAZN VALUES – THE ‘HOW’ IN WHAT WE DO:**

Agility and creativity fuel growth and innovation, to **Make It Happen.**

Prioritising what matters drives progress and positive outcomes, **Focusing On Impact.**

Collective ambition builds optimism and success, in order to **Win As One.**

At DAZN, we are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that values equality and diversity, where everyone can contribute and have their voices heard. This means hiring and developing talent across all races, ethnicities, religions, age groups, sexual orientations, gender identities and abilities.
